title: BP-2c2a3c1d's answer regex rejects the placeholder paraphrase /plugin install <plugin>@<marketplace>
goal: The first check of BP-2c2a3c1d (bench_scenarios.csv and bench_pool.csv) matches a correct paraphrase with angle-bracket placeholders around the @ as well as a literal plugin id; the two files change in step and pool check passes

run: import re,sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_pool as b;p=json.loads(next(x for x in b.read_csv(b.PUBLIC_FILE) if x['id']=='BP-2c2a3c1d')['checks'])[0];r=[bool(re.search(p,a)) for a in ['/plugin install my-plugin@my-marketplace','/plugin install <plugin>@<marketplace>']];print(r);sys.exit(0 if all(r) else 1)
